## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Restore video titles and thumbnails in Android media controls during normal playback. ([#28](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/28))
- Apply the selected theme to the empty saved-NG message and its background. ([#27](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/27))
- Use subdued dark backgrounds for NG registration and deletion, with smaller delete buttons.
- Restore single-tap expansion for truncated comments and reserve NG actions for long presses. ([#31](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/31))
- Recognize rapid double taps without opening NG settings. ([#31](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/31))
- Ask for confirmation before deleting a saved NG setting.
